description: Dutch PII test set for the privacy-engine spike (PLAN §7 P3). Each case carries the text to scan, a category (what kind of PII or negative probe it is) and the expected privacy class under the Knooppunt mapping: valid BSN / medical / legal / secret / IBAN+name-combo → confidential; any other PII (phone, postcode, email, bare IBAN, BSN-context digit runs) → sensitive; checksum-failing lookalikes and clean chat → safe (fail-toward-privacy applies to uncertain detection, never to definite checksum negatives).
